citations.assessment: The internal entry is itself marked as unlocated.
The cited dossier gives the alternate place of yod in the father’s name and addresses the theft account.

The Bavli gives Rabbi Elyashiv in the theft account. Rashi supplies the merit explanation. Ein Yaakov gives Yitzchak bar Elyashiv with part of the name parenthetical. Yerushalmi gives a different event when Rabbi Yitzchak died.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
